Notes from the tool output: /das is the main 2-D DAS strain-rate array (30000 time samples x 384 channels); /t and /trace are the per-sample time (float64) and trace index (int64) vectors of length 30000; /channel, /x, /y, /z are per-channel metadata vectors of length 384 (channel IDs as int32; easting/northing/depth coordinates as float32); /crs is a scalar (shape ()) stored as uint8. No datasets were missed — the root key list and the recursive visit both returned the same 8 names.
